headline: HOU @ DET matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is HOU 3.97 at DET 4.54, with a projected total of 8.52. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward DET: HOU moved +0.05 runs while DET moved +0.47, changing the projected margin by -0.42 runs. The projected total climbed +0.52, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability rose +11.4%, so the first-inning read became more pitcher-friendly early. Pitching context: Keider Montero has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 1.6 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Kevin McGonigle, Isaac Paredes, Jeremy Peña, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Brice Matthews, James Outman because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
